description: Set up the contact buttons (chat widget) in a portal — WhatsApp, Telegram, email, phone, Instagram and so on. Pass channels as an object {whatsapp: '+380...', telegram: '@mybot', email: 'info@...', phone: '+380...'}.

channels.description: Contact channels. Available keys: whatsapp, telegram, messenger, viber, email, phone, instagram, snapchat, line, vk, sms, slack, skype, apple, linkedin, twitter, map, waze, tiktok, envelope, link. The value is a link or a phone number.

portal_id.description: Portal ID (optional — if not given, the first portal is used)

name: configure_chat
